instruction.text: Elijah brings 2 pencil cases to school. He puts 5 pencils into each pencil case. How many pencils does he bring to school in total?
Freya buys 4 bouquets. Each bouquet contains 10 flowers. How many flowers does she buy in total?
Niran makes 5 batches of cupcakes. Each batch contains 10 cupcakes. How many cupcakes does he make in total?
Lucia paints 6 pictures. She paints 2 trees in each picture. How many trees does she paint in total?
Dohyun buys 3 boxes of apples. Each box contains 5 apples. How many apples does he buy in total?
Iris runs laps for 8 days in a row. She runs 2 laps each day. How many laps does she run in total?
Casper has 7 bags of marbles. Each bag contains 10 marbles. How many marbles does he have in total?
Ramona gives stickers to 4 friends. She gives each friend 5 stickers. How many stickers does she give to friends in total?
